== Summary ==
This is all that can be collected before [[../../Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 1|Dungeon 1]], and it's clearly less equipment than in Quest 1:
* 4 Heart Containers instead of 3
* Wooden sword
* Magical Shield instead of small shield
* Blue Ring
* Bombs and Blue Candle
* Power Bracelet and Red Potion (''difficult'')
